data.title: 圣路易斯 · 晨曦套房的露肩军服优雅早安
data.description: 奢华高层套房主卧被初升的朝阳染上一层柔和的金辉。圣路易斯坐在床沿，身穿标志性的白蓝联邦露肩军官制服。短款深蓝外套轻挽在圆润的香肩两侧，白色百褶短裙衬托出匀称修长的双腿。她双手交叠伸了个舒缓的懒腰，天蓝色长发在晨风中微扬，眼波流转间尽显成熟舰娘特有的端庄与娇媚。
data.location: sunlit penthouse master bed with silk sheets

data.promptProse: Warm early sunlight fills a luxury high-rise suite bedroom where St. Louis sits perched on the edge of the bed with her arms raised in a graceful morning stretch. She glances toward the viewer with poise and gentle, inviting warmth.
data.animaCaption: Seated along the sunlit hotel suite bed edge, she laces her fingers overhead in a languid morning stretch as her cropped navy naval jacket slips off her bare shoulders above her white pleated miniskirt and thigh-high stockings.
data.nsfwProse: She wears her signature Eagle Union uniform with the cropped navy jacket resting off her bare shoulders, paired with a short white pleated skirt, gloves, and white thigh-high stockings.
